topic: RFC 5545 iCalendar standard for recurring events and scheduling

title: RFC 5545: Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core Object Specification
snippet: RFC 5545 defines the iCalendar data format for representing and exchanging calendaring and scheduling information such as events, to-dos, journal entries, and free/busy information.
claim: RFC 5545 is the IETF standard for iCalendar scheduling data format

topic: RRULE (Recurrence Rule) grammar for expressing recurring schedules
query: RFC 5545 recurrence rules iCalendar scheduling standard
title: Recurring Calendar Events: RRULE Explained | Nylas CLI
snippet: An RRULE is the recurrence rule grammar defined in RFC 5545 that describes a repeating schedule as a single string. For example FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO means every Monday.
claim: RRULE syntax enables compact expression of complex recurring schedules per RFC 5545

topic: RFC 5545 FREQ parameter values from SECONDLY to YEARLY
query: RFC 5545 recurrence rules iCalendar scheduling standard
title: RRULE Generator: Create Custom Recurrence Rules for iCalendar
snippet: The FREQ rule part identifies the type of recurrence rule with valid values including SECONDLY, MINUTELY, HOURLY, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, and YEARLY to specify repeating events based on various intervals.
claim: RFC 5545 defines FREQ values spanning second to yearly granularity

topic: Universal calendar application support for RFC 5545 RRULEs
query: RFC 5545 recurrence rules iCalendar scheduling standard
title: Recurring Calendar Events: RRULE Explained | Nylas CLI
snippet: RRULEs are understood by Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar and most scheduling software because they are part of the iCalendar standard RFC 5545.
claim: RFC 5545 RRULEs are universally supported by major calendar systems
Temporal supports cron-based scheduling as Unix-compatible alternative to RFC 5545
query: Temporal workflow orchestration RFC 5545 scheduling cron 2025
read:
A Temporal Cron Job is similar to a classic unix cron job.
Just as a unix cron job accepts a command and a schedule on which to execute that command, a Cron Schedule can be provided with the call to spawn a Workflow Execution.
If a Cron Schedule is provided, the Temporal Server will spawn an execution for the associated Workflow Type per the schedule.
snippet: A Temporal Cron Job is similar to a classic unix cron job.
title: Temporal Cron Job | Temporal Documentation
topic: Temporal Cron Jobs following Unix cron model with UTC interpretation
Temporal Schedules providing flexible interval and calendar-based expressions
query: Temporal workflow orchestration RFC 5545 scheduling cron 2025
title: Schedule | Temporal Documentation
snippet: Schedules provide a more flexible and user-friendly approach than Temporal Cron Jobs with more configuration options. There are two kinds of Schedule Spec: a simple interval like every 30 minutes, and a calendar-based expression similar to cron expressions.
claim: Temporal Schedules support both interval and calendar-based expressions
